title: Key Account Manager CEE
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing!
Join Neogen as a Key Account Specialist, CEE and play a pivotal role in strengthening strategic customer partnerships across Poland and the wider Central and Eastern European region. In this senior-level commercial role, you will work closely with Food Processors and Contract Laboratories, helping them achieve their food safety objectives through tailored Neogen Food Safety Solutions. Your ability to build trusted relationships, identify growth opportunities, and deliver data-driven account strategies will directly support customer success and business growth.
Key Responsibilities

• Build, develop, and maintain strong, long-term relationships with strategic accounts, including Food Processors and Contract Laboratories.

• Engage with stakeholders across customer organisations-including quality, laboratory, procurement, and senior management teams-to understand business needs and position relevant Neogen Food Safety Solutions.

• Develop and execute strategic account plans to increase customer value, strengthen partnerships, and drive sustainable revenue growth.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned key accounts, responding to enquiries, resolving issues, and proactively identifying opportunities to enhance the customer experience.

• Conduct regular business reviews, monitor account performance and KPIs, and use insights from CRM tools such as Salesforce to recommend improvements and support continuous growth.

• Collaborate with internal teams, including the EMEA Corporate Account Team, Professional Services, Marketing, and Customer Support, while monitoring market developments and competitor activity to refine account strategies.

Job Requirements

• Demonstrated experience in key account management, strategic sales, business development, or a comparable customer-facing commercial role.

• Experience working with, or strong knowledge of, the food processing, food safety, laboratory, or related industries.

• Proven ability to build relationships with stakeholders at different organisational levels and translate customer needs into effective solutions.

• Strong commercial and analytical capability, with experience using performance data and KPIs to manage accounts and identify growth opportunities.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to work effectively across internal and external teams.

• Professional fluency in Polish and English, together with the ability to travel as required to support customers and business priorities.

What We Offer

• A senior, customer-focused role with the opportunity to make a meaningful impact across strategic accounts in the CEE region.

• The opportunity to represent a recognised portfolio of food safety solutions and support customers in protecting product quality and consumer wellbeing.

• Collaboration with experienced regional and cross-functional teams in an international business environment.

• A standard benefits package.

• Opportunities to contribute to commercial strategy, customer success, and continuous improvement within a dynamic market.

If you are a commercially minded relationship builder with a passion for delivering value to customers, we would love to hear from you. Join our team and help shape the future of food safety partnerships across Central and Eastern Europe.
Come Be Part Of A Mission that Matters! From inside the farm gate to our dinner plates, Neogen protects the world’s food supply. Through a variety of animal healthcare products, to food safety solutions for dangerous bacteria, allergens, toxins, drug residues and much more, Neogen is there - and you can be too.

title: Senior Paid Media Strategist, Meta and Google (Client-Facing)
description:
Senior Paid Media Strategist, Meta and Google (Client-Facing)
Job Overview
MVR Digital is hiring a Senior Paid Media Strategist to own Meta and Google strategy and execution for a portfolio of premium and luxury DTC brands. You will be in Ads Manager and Google Ads daily, and you will own the cross-channel budget call. You will also set the strategy and defend it on client calls.
About MVR Digital

MVR Digital is a performance marketing agency working with premium and luxury DTC and e-commerce brands to grow profitably online. Adweek named us one of the Fastest Growing Agencies. We work across Meta, Google, TikTok, and Connected TV, plus email, creative, and landing pages. The team is fully remote, direct, and focused on results.
Our Values

• Act Like an Owner

• Clarity over Complexity

• Serve Clients’ Best Interest

• We Win Together, We Lose Together

• Data-Informed, Human-Led

What Success Looks Like
Your mission is to run 3 to 4 client accounts, each at $100K+ a month in combined Meta and Google spend, so that performance moves toward target without leadership in the daily details. In your first year:

• By month 4, 80% or more of your accounts are green against their monthly goals

• Zero client-seen launch errors each quarter, across both platforms and Merchant Center

• Every test closes with a written verdict in the change log

• By month 3, fewer than 2 media questions a month reach leadership from your clients

• Budget moves between Meta and Google are backed by MER and incrementality evidence, not platform-reported ROAS

What You Will Do

• Own Meta and Google strategy and daily execution across your accounts: build, structure, budget pacing, testing, and scaling

• Manage $100K+ per month in combined spend against MER, ROAS, and CPA targets

• On Meta: run Advantage+ and CBO structures, protect signal quality, and configure and QA pixel, CAPI, and event quality yourself

• On Google: manage Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and YouTube, including asset groups, exclusions, signal inputs, and new customer acquisition settings

• Own Merchant Center and feed health end to end. Diagnose disapprovals, feed gaps, and Shopify sync issues yourself

• Hold a real position on branded spend and incrementality, and walk a client through it

• Decide where the next dollar goes across Meta and Google when both platforms claim the same conversions

• Run structured creative testing. Brief creative, critique what comes back, and connect creative performance to your in-platform decisions

• Support TikTok and other channels where they affect your accounts

• Lead the paid media portion of client calls. Explain performance clearly, bring a recommendation, and push back when a request will not serve the client

What We Are Looking For

• 5+ years of hands-on paid media at an agency or high-growth brand

• Deep expertise on at least one of Meta or Google, and proven, hands-on ownership of the other. You have personally run both, not supervised them

• Personally owned $100K+ monthly budgets with documented efficiency gains, with meaningful spend on each platform

• Strong Meta fundamentals: Advantage+, CBO, signal quality, CAPI

• Strong Google fundamentals: Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Merchant Center, and feed troubleshooting

• DTC or e-commerce ownership. Premium or luxury AOV experience is a strong differentiator

• GA4, Looker Studio, Shopify, and attribution fluency

• Fluent, confident English and strong client communication. This role is client-facing

• Comfortable managing multiple accounts in a fast-moving remote environment

Role Details

• Full-time independent contractor

• Fully remote. Based in the US or Canada, with overlap with US time zones for client calls

Perks

• Paid time off

• Paid company holidays

• Flexible Fridays

• Remote-first collaboration

• Quarterly bonus opportunities

In this role you will be responsible for the end-to-end engineering lifecycle, from translating business requirements into robust technical designs, to writing production-quality code, to deploying cloud-native services and supporting them through their full operational lifespan. • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills, with the discipline to investigate problems methodically and document findings clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience designing and operating event-driven architectures using Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent streaming platforms.

• Familiarity with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes in production environments.

title: Tech Lead - Autonomy Performance, Robotaxi
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Robotaxi Teams

The Robotaxi team is taking Wayve's AI Driver to its first public-scale deployment, with fare-paying riders on global ride-hail platforms. This team owns the end-to-end performance operating system for the product: the metrics, triage, and release gates that decide whether the autonomy is good enough to ship, and stays great release over release. For an end-to-end learned driving system, there's no existing playbook to follow: this team is defining what "performance" means from scratch.

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Own and evolve the autonomy performance measurement framework for Robotaxi (driving + pick-up/drop-off): the metrics, dashboards, and narrative leadership uses to make ship/no-ship decisions

- Build and run the end-to-end performance improvement loop: detect issues, triage and prioritise, drive root-cause investigations, and land fixes across model, robot software, backend, and evaluation tooling

- Lead cross-functional execution across AV core, evaluation/validation, robotics, robot software, triage/systems, and SRE, aligning roadmaps to performance outcomes without direct reporting authority

- Define and enforce performance release gates and regression detection for production deployments, owning readiness calls and incident follow-through

- Stay hands-on in the data and code when needed (Python/C++/SQL) to accelerate debugging and unblock delivery

🧩 What you'll be working on:

- Standing up Robotaxi's performance operating system from scratch: metrics, triage funnel, release gates, and rollback plans for an end-to-end learned driving system with no existing playbook to copy

- External-facing performance reporting that's trusted and repeatable enough to share directly with partners like Uber

- Integrating new model features and architectures from core engineering into live Robotaxi operations

- The stack underneath it all: WayveCode (Python + C++), Looker, Databricks/SQL, Grafana, and internal evaluation and sim tooling

- In your first 90 days: mapping the top prioritised fixes across backend, robot, and driving model, and shipping a new driving model deployment and robot software release end-to-end

👤 You should apply if:

- You've demonstrated cross-functional engineering leadership, steering complex delivery across multiple teams and stakeholders to production outcomes, without relying on direct line management

- You bring a strong product and customer orientation, and can connect technical performance metrics to rider experience, operational outcomes, and launch readiness

- You have strong autonomy/robotics performance debugging experience, including deep hands-on work with real-world issues and time-series/real-time signals, rather than just managing a queue

- You have strong technical foundations in learned systems/ML-driven robotics, and can reason about model behaviour, failure modes, and measurement pitfalls in data-driven autonomy stacks

- You're production-fluent in Python, C++, and SQL, comfortable working directly in code and analytics pipelines to diagnose problems and validate improvements

- You have experience owning or co-owning releases to a fleet of robots/vehicles in production, including release processes, gates, rollback plans, and regression handling

- You're familiar with modern data/observability stacks used in autonomy programs (e.g. Databricks/SQL, Grafana, internal eval/sim tooling)

🌱 Not ticking every box? That's totally okay! If you're passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement.

title: Program Integrity Contract Lead
description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Program Integrity (PI) Contract Lead is an important member of the leadership team and works directly with Program Integrity Leadership, the Compliance Officer, and the Compliance Committee. This position requires a strong understanding of the VA Community Care Network (CCN) program, including, but not limited to, federal health care program requirements, Executive Order 12549, Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 3, the Federal False Claims Act, and applicable state and federal laws governing program integrity and compliance.

The PI Contract Lead analyzes and evaluates the effectiveness of existing business processes and develops sustainable, repeatable, and measurable process improvements. You will participate in and influence departmental and cross-functional strategy discussions, recommending changes needed to maintain compliance with contractual obligations and regulatory requirements. You will address issues of varied scope and complexity, ranging from moderate to significant. The PI Contract Lead works collaboratively with key stakeholders to provide consultative support, internal briefings, training, and participation in integrated care planning, as needed. You will partner with stakeholders to identify, develop, and implement corrective actions. description:
Conceive, Create and Contribute to Cityscope

Creative expression is all about putting across your thoughts without limitations. We, at Cityscope would love for you to do just that. Whether you have a flair for writing an article or producing a video, we have got you covered. Being a local information, news and commerce platform, we are always looking to feature good stories and magnify your voices.
So, if you have an original topic or story idea in mind and have worked on a piece, dos end in your work to - .
Who can contribute?
You don’t have to be a professional writer, video producer or photographer. If you have something enriching and value-adding to share - be it about a person, place, product or point at issue, put pen to paper or capture it on camera. And, share it with us.What kind of content are we looking for? Go through the Cityscope website and look at the kind of topics/issues covered as well as how it’s presented. However, this does not mean you need to restrain yourself. Here are a few examples:

• Articles including feature or news stories, individual profiles, in-depth pieces, opinions, listicles, etc.

• Photo collections

• Videos in conjunction with interviews, tutorials, stories, news

• Memes, illustrations, comic strips, technology tips, mythbusters, data driven visualisations. Let your imagination run free! If it’s interesting to you, others will also find it so.

How long should the articles and videos be?
Articles can run anywhere from 500 to 800 words and should be accompanied with appropriate images. Some may run longer (to a maximum of 1,000 words) if they’re really compelling. Videos can run up to 3 to 4 minutes.
How does the process work?

• Do not forget to include some details about yourself and your background and/ or interests. In case your work has been published previously, send us the relevant links.2. We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

 Benchling's platform helps the world's largest biotech and pharma companies develop therapies faster. As a Product Manager on the Study Lifecycle team, you'll work on products such as Studies, Sample Testing, and Process Development that scientists use to do their jobs. These products are fundamental to how scientific work gets organized, planned, and connected to analysis across different phases of a drug's development cycle.

We launched Bioprocess in 2024 to help process development teams design, execute, and analyze the experiments that turn a molecule into a manufacturable drug. In 2025, we announced a partnership with Merck (press release https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/benchling-announces-collaboration-with-merck-on-vaccine-bioanalysis-302478378.html) to help their teams develop and test vaccines faster by bringing their analytical workflows onto a single platform.

Today, we're implementing the largest pharma companies in the world on Bioprocess, making the core product better every quarter, and expanding into Analytical Sciences and downstream QC. Our vision is to become the software that helps biopharmas bring therapies to patients twice as fast.

You'll be working at the intersection of experimental planning, execution data, and analysis, deciding how a single study ties them together around a scientific question. You'll figure out how to make powerful software feel intuitive to the scientists who depend on it every day, and dependable for the teams who integrate with it through our APIs.

You do not need a life sciences background. We're looking for a systems thinker with product taste who can walk into an unfamiliar domain, find the structural patterns, and be effective quickly. The best PMs we've seen for this kind of work have diverse backgrounds. They've built products across meaningfully different problem spaces and bring transferable instincts rather than a single industry playbook.

You're accountable for the roadmap and the outcomes your roadmap produces, for scientists who use the product and for the customers and partners who integrate with it through our APIs.

- To inform what you build, you will spend time with customers and GTM teams to understand how scientists actually work, and how to turn what they ask for into what they need. It's your responsibility to bring that context back to the team and turn it into product direction.

title: Aerodynamics Expert (MSc. or PhD)
description:
Aerodynamics Expert (MSc. or PhD)
Pay: $80-$120/hour
Location: Global, fully remote
Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)
Schedule: Flexible-you can choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired
We are looking for a highly skilled Aerodynamics Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving computational fluid dynamics, aerodynamic analysis, engineering simulation, and Python.
The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks that can be completed through programmatic, command-line-based workflows. A representative task may require analyzing an airfoil, preparing a computational domain and mesh, defining appropriate boundary conditions, running a CFD simulation, calculating lift and drag, and determining whether the resulting flow field is numerically and physically valid.
What You’ll Work On

• Solve and validate aerodynamic and fluid-dynamics problems.

• Translate physical requirements into computational models and solver-ready cases.

• Create or modify geometries, computational domains, and meshes.

• Define appropriate initial conditions, boundary conditions, fluid properties, and solver settings.

• Run CFD and aerodynamic-analysis workflows using command-line-accessible tools.

• Use Python to automate preprocessing, simulation execution, parameter sweeps, postprocessing, and validation.

Required Qualifications

• An MS or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering with an aerodynamics, fluid dynamics, or thermofluids specialization; or

• A BS in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering plus at least 1-2 years of aero-specific professional or research experience.

• Strong understanding of fluid mechanics and applied aerodynamics.

• Experience formulating and executing CFD or aerodynamic analyses.

• Practical proficiency with Python .

• Experience with at least one engineering tool or library that can be operated through a CLI, scripting interface, configuration files, or programmatic API.

• Ability to select and justify modeling assumptions, boundary conditions, mesh strategies, and solver settings.

• Ability to diagnose non-convergence, unstable solutions, incorrect results, and physically invalid outputs.

• Ability to communicate technical reasoning and engineering trade-offs clearly.

Relevant tools may include Python, OpenFOAM, SU2, Gmsh, FEniCSx, Elmer, CalculiX, SciPy , or similar programmatic engineering software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.
Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter , solver APIs, mesh-processing libraries, or domain-specific scientific packages. No single library is mandatory.
Process

• Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.

• Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.

• Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure
Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.
Minimum submission requirements apply.
Start Timeline & Availability

• We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24-48 hours of completing onboarding.

title: Specialista/ka zákaznické péče s němčinou
description:
V Rohlíku je Customer Care jedním z důvodů, proč jsme love brand. Zákazníci nás pravidelně chválí na sociálních sítích - protože jsme rychlí, lidští a protože nám na nich opravdu záleží.

Jako Specialista/ka zákaznické péče s němčinou budeš v první linii téhle zkušenosti. Budeš pomáhat zákazníkům přes telefon, e-mail a chat, řešit i složitější situace (včetně těch, které AI zatím nezvládne), a postaráš se o to, aby každý kontakt skončil s pocitem, že zákazník byl vyslyšen a dostal skutečnou pomoc.

 

Proč je tahle role zajímavá

- Budeš reprezentovat značku známou špičkovým zákaznickým servisem - a každý den pomáhat nastavovat laťku.

- Budeš pracovat se skutečnými lidmi a reálnými situacemi - žádné čtení skriptů, ale opravdové řešení problémů.

- Čeká tě inbound i outbound komunikace, nejen odpovídání na dotazy.

- Přidáš se do týmu, který drží spolu a zakládá si na tom, že věci dělá pořádně.

- Hybridní režim: po zapracování (obvykle 1-2 měsíce) je možný home office - 3 dny v kanceláři, 2 dny Home Office.

 

Co tě u nás čeká

- Komunikace se zákazníky přes e-mail, telefon a chat (inbound i outbound)

- Řešení požadavků, jako jsou změny času doručení, adresy, úpravy položek nebo kontaktních údajů

- Pomoc zákazníkům ve chvíli, kdy se něco pokazí - opožděné objednávky, problémy s doručením, reklamace

- Koordinace s kurýry, aby objednávky dorazily úspěšně a včas

- Úzká spolupráce s dalšími týmy (Logistika, Nákup apod.), aby se problémy řešily rychle

- Poskytování přesných informací o produktech a službách

- Sbírání zákaznické zpětné vazby a její sdílení, abychom naše služby dál zlepšovali

- Možnost kompenzovat reklamace kredity v rámci daných pravidel

- Přispívání k dobré atmosféře v týmu - Customer Care je týmový sport

 

Co od tebe potřebujeme

- Zkušenost ze zákaznického servisu nebo jiné zákaznicky orientované role

- Němčina je nutnost (pokročilá úroveň) - psaná i mluvená

- Čeština/slovenština je nutnost

- Angličtina je výhodou / silným plusem - psaná i mluvená

- Silné komunikační schopnosti a přirozeně prozákaznický přístup

- Odolnost vůči stresu a schopnost klidně zvládat konfliktní situace

- Schopnost rychle se učit a pracovat se základními nástroji (Google Workspace)

- Umíš přemýšlet kreativně a hledat pro zákazníka to nejlepší možné řešení, i když situace není úplně standardní.

- Ochota pracovat na směny je nutná, role může zahrnovat i práci o víkendech.

 

Co z toho budeš mít

- Férovou odměnu - Dostaneš fixní mzdu a variabilní část. Dobrá práce si zaslouží jasné a férové uznání.

- Dobré jídlo každý den - Každý den si můžeš dát oběd zdarma a v kanceláři tě čeká čerstvé ovoce a zelenina. Protože dobré jídlo dělá dobrou práci.

- Život, nejen práce - Skutečná flexibilita - tři dny v kanceláři, 2 dny Home Office. A ano, máme i neomezenou placenou dovolenou založenou na důvěře.

- Osobní růst - Porosteš stejně rychle jako Rohlík. Každá výzva je příležitost naučit se něco nového a zanechat stopu.

- Reálný dopad - To, co děláš, má smysl. Uvidíš, jak tvoje práce mění způsob, jakým lidé jedí a žijí - od prvního dne.

- Uznání mezi kolegy - Tvoje úsilí nezůstane bez povšimnutí. Můžeš ocenit ostatní (a být oceněn) díky peer kreditům, které využiješ v naší interní „kavárně“.

- Xtra členství - Získáš členství Xtra zdarma a 10% cashback na všechny nákupy na Rohlik.cz http://Rohlik.cz.

- Sport a wellbeing - Zůstaneš v pohybu díky firemním sportovním výzvám nebo dotované Multisport kartě.

- Tým, který drží při sobě - Budeš pracovat s lidmi, kteří jedou naplno, navzájem se podporují a společně slaví úspěchy.

- Zní to jako ty? - Jsi člověk, který bere věci do vlastních rukou, jedná rychle a dotahuje věci do konce? Tak pojď s námi „upéct“ něco skvělého.

title: Staff Security Engineer (IAM)
description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

About the Role

Nubank is seeking a Staff Security Engineer to contribute in the Identity and Access Management security function across a financial technology organization serving over 100 million customers in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia.
This is a senior individual-contributor role with organizational-level technical influence, responsible for supporting a multi-year IAM security strategy, directing its execution across multiple engineering teams, and ensuring that identity and access controls meet the security, regulatory, and operational requirements of a globally operating financial institution.

The Staff Security Engineer is expected to bring a demonstrated history of delivering consequential security programs - including programs that encountered setbacks - and the technical judgment that only sustained, hands-on experience in the domain produces.
Critically, this role requires a security engineering philosophy grounded in business enablement: the conviction that security done well accelerates what the organization can do, not merely protects it. This means rigorously distinguishing between controls that reduce real risk and those that create the appearance of compliance without reducing exposure, taking genuine ownership of outcomes rather than delegating accountability through policy, and continuously questioning inherited assumptions about what security measures are necessary, sufficient, or proportionate.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

- Defining, communicating, and executing a multi-year security strategy (especially in the IAM field) aligned with the organization's risk posture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions.

- Lead organization-wide authentication migrations that span heterogeneous surfaces - browser, operating system login, CLI tooling, and API-level integrations - across thousands of employees, multiple device ecosystems, and distributed work environments, producing measurable outcomes: authentication success rates above 99%, material reductions in per-authentication time, support exception rates below 1%, and return on investment within weeks of enforcement.

- Designing and maintaining the core identity infrastructure with the durability and operational discipline required at organizational scale: enterprise Identity Provider, PKI and X.509 certificate lifecycle automation, mutual TLS for service-to-service authentication, and credential management systems engineered to remain sound as the organization grows.

- Translating least-privilege access from a principle into a measurable, organization-wide program - with defined metrics, visible adoption curves, and accountability structures that allow Security and Engineering leadership to track and act on the organization's access risk posture over time.

- Designing and maintaining a security engineering framework - comprising technical mechanisms, policies, incentives, and assurance processes - that ensures security properties are durable, verifiable, and operationally sound, rather than dependent on individual vigilance or periodic audits.

- Leading technical incident response for identity and access security events, including critical vulnerabilities in remote access infrastructure, ensuring thorough investigation, documented root cause analysis, and structural improvements that reduce the likelihood and impact of recurrence.

We’re looking for a Senior Delivery Manager, Data & Models to own delivery across Mission Lane ’s data and modeling work, from intake through deployment and ongoing maintenance, reporting to the Senior Director, Portfolio Prioritization & Delivery.

A customer opens the app and finds a credit line that has grown, a decision that came back quickly, or a next step explained in plain language. Behind each of those moments is data that is trusted and available, and often a model that has been built, validated, and approved to use it.
The Senior Delivery Manager, Data & Models shapes how that work gets planned, sequenced, and delivered. Data platforms, pipelines, and products feed nearly everything we do, and models are one of the highest-stakes things built on top of them. Every initiative crosses data engineering, data science, credit, risk, and compliance, and each group works to its own rhythm and its own standards. Your puzzle is sequencing that work so the right things ship in the right order, with governance built in rather than bolted on, keeping speed and rigor in balance.

• Delivery practices for data work such as pipeline and platform changes, data product releases, and data quality remediation, with the same clarity on ownership and handoffs

• Operational point of contact responsibilities for 2nd line credit and model risk management bank oversight

• Continuous improvement of how we plan and deliver, using delivery data and retrospectives to reduce coordination overhead and rework

• Informal guidance for less experienced delivery colleagues as delivery practice takes shape

You’ll thrive in this role if:

• You see delivery risk early. You notice the missing data dependency, the skipped validation step, or the sequencing conflict, trace it to its source, and bring a recommendation to the table.

• You are at home in data-heavy work and understand how data quality, lineage, and availability shape what can ship and when. You know how models are built, validated, governed, and deployed well enough to plan around the work and discuss it credibly with the data scientists, credit partners, and model risk reviewers who do it every day.

• You lead across teams you don’t manage. You build trust early, bring teams to a plan everyone understands, and explain the “why” behind new ways of working so teams adopt them and keep using them.

• You make sound sequencing and priority calls as the picture develops.

• You communicate with precision: clear plans, clear status, clear escalation, and no ambiguity about who owns what or what happens next.

title: Senior+ Software Engineer - Integrations Platform
description:
The Role
Healthcare data is fragmented by default. Every provider, payer, EHR, referral source, and clinical system speaks a slightly different language. For Frontera to scale, both as a care delivery organization and as a technology platform, that fragmentation has to disappear behind a reliable, extensible integration and data layer.
As a Senior+ Software Engineer on our Integrations Platform, you'll be the technical lead for that layer, owning it end-to-end.
This role sits within our ML & Data organization because we don't view integrations as implementation plumbing. The systems we connect determine what data Frontera can access, how cleanly we can understand it, and ultimately what our product and AI systems can do with it. Every integration expands the number of organizations Frontera can work with, and adds breadth, fidelity, and context to the clinical data underlying the platform. That is the same longitudinal dataset that comes from operating real care alongside our own platform, not abstract transaction data.
This is a hands-on role. You'll spend roughly 70% of your time building, deep in the code and shaping architecture decisions, and the remainder working across Product, Clinical Operations, ML/Data, and external partners to make sure we're solving the right problems. You'll be the engineering owner for integrations from day one. Managing people is not a requirement at the start, but as integration volume and complexity grow, there's a clear path to growing the team and stepping into formal lead responsibilities.
What You'll Do

• Act as the tech lead for integrations, with end-to-end ownership of discovery, data mapping, implementation, reliability, observability, and long-term maintainability

• Own the integration architecture: design how Frontera connects with external healthcare systems (EHRs, partners, and other data sources), establishing reusable patterns and tooling rather than one-off builds for each new organization

• Identify which problems are worth solving, not just solve the ones you're assigned. You'll help define the right answer where the specification doesn't yet exist, working directly with external technical teams and internal stakeholders

• Bring an AI-informed lens to the work itself: use agentic tooling to accelerate data mapping and schema discovery across new partner systems, rather than treating each integration as a fully manual build. Judgment on when to automate discovery versus handle a partner's edge cases by hand is part of the craft

• Shape the unified data model underneath those integrations, in close partnership with ML/Data, Product, Engineering, and Clinical Operations

• Set clear standards for data quality, error handling, monitoring, and operational ownership as integration volume grows

• Help determine what should become platform capability versus what should be solved pragmatically for a specific partner or workflow

• Raise the technical bar for the team by mentoring engineers, setting working norms, and contributing to hiring as the function scales

Why This Matters
Better integrations mean faster onboarding of new organizations, less operational friction for clinicians and teams, and a more complete view of the care journey. They also improve the quality and usefulness of the data Frontera can learn from, because we operate care directly and that data reflects real clinical workflows and outcomes. As that dataset grows, it becomes increasingly important to how we evaluate care models, build AI systems, improve workflows, and differentiate the platform. This role is one of the foundational technical layers behind that scale strategy.
Qualifications

• 6+ years of experience in backend-leaning software engineering, with strong experience building APIs, integration systems, or distributed backend services

• Track record of owning technically complex projects end-to-end, with ownership that extends beyond your own lane

• Experience building and scaling integration p

title: Sr. Director, VAR & Channel Partnerships
description:
As Sr. Director, VAR & Channel Partnerships at vCluster Labs, you aren’t just signing reseller agreements; you are building and leading the global partner channel that lets the world’s AI infrastructure resellers sell tenant isolation without us in the room.

Enterprises do not buy AI infrastructure one product at a time. They buy it from the reseller who already holds the paper, the services capacity, and the trust. Your first targets are the partners where our path to the money is right now: WWT and Computacenter, then SHI, CDW, and the national and regional VARs that actually sell AI infrastructure. You can pull in distributors, and the OEM and ISV partners your peers own, where they accelerate a deal; the global system integrators (Accenture, Deloitte, EY) stay with the VP.

This is a founding, zero-to-one role on a first-year partner program. You start as an individual contributor: there is no channel to inherit, and you will carry the first partners and the first number yourself. As the channel proves out, you will hire and lead the team that scales it globally. Success is measured in partner-sourced bookings, transacting partners, and registered deals that close. Not in logos signed.

As Sr. Director, VAR & Channel Partnerships, your role will include:

- Global partner leadership: You will own vCluster’s global VAR and channel partnerships end to end: the strategy, the executive relationships, and the commercial results. You will be vCluster’s senior voice with partner leadership across North America, EMEA, and APJ, and you will decide where we invest and where we do not.

- Recruitment and activation: You will recruit against a filter, not for coverage. A short list of VARs who can actually source AI infrastructure and platform engineering deals beats a long list who cannot. You will own the path from first conversation to first transaction: agreement, track admission, enablement, first registered deal, and first close. You will also retire non-performing partners without drama. Time from signature to first dollar is your headline metric.

- Transaction mechanics: You will own the partner commercial model: tier discounts, deal-registration uplift, renewal margin, volume incentives, and named-account bonuses. You will run deal registration and Partner of Record, including regional PoR, active-engagement standards, renewal rights, and conflict resolution that holds up when two partners claim the same account. You will build distribution where it scales the motion, while keeping the quoting and order path clean enough that partners do not route around it.

- Field alignment: You will make co-sell comp-neutral so our sellers get full quota credit and never fight the channel. You will build named-account maps between vCluster sellers and partner sellers, with deal registration the field trusts. You will give partner sellers a reason to lead with vCluster: margin they can count on, services attach they can sell, and a technical story their SEs can carry.

- Multi-party plays with the ecosystem: You will connect VAR opportunities to the NVIDIA alliance and the OEM and ISV design wins your peers land, so a WWT or Computacenter seller can quote a validated stack with vCluster already inside it. Where a distributor accelerates a deal, you bring them in.

- Enablement, marketing, and MDF: You will own sales and technical certification for your partners and hold the tier requirements. You will run joint marketing with pipeline objectives attached: field events, webinars, named-account campaigns, and customer stories. You will approve MDF against pipeline outcomes and enforce proof of performance. Discretionary spend earns its return or it stops.

- Building the team: You will design the channel organization: the roles, the hiring sequence, and the coverage model by region and partner tier. As partner revenue grows, you will hire and lead partner managers and partner engineers, starting with the roles that unlock the most revenue.

• Eliminating configuration drift across cells, and building the tooling that keeps it eliminated.

• Standing up the regression suite that lets us upgrade LSF on a schedule rather than on a dare.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Lightspeed's Data Office is hiring a Senior Analytics Engineer to design and own the data models that drive decisions across financial performance, GTM activities, and product insights. You'll partner with stakeholders across Finance, Revenue Ops, Marketing, and Product to deliver the analytics foundation the business runs on.

If you are someone who enjoys building data pipelines that power real business decisions and want to design canonical models that unify fragmented source systems across multiple CRMs, ERPs, and product platforms, then this role is for you. You can sit down with Finance to talk revenue recognition or with Product to map activation funnels, and walk away with a clear data model in your head. You hold a high bar on quality, push back constructively when it matters, and don't wait to be handed a well-defined problem. You scope the work, drive it to completion, and bring others along.

What you’ll be responsible for:

- Design and build the data models that power the business: financial reporting (GTV, MRR, revenue recognition), GTM analytics, and product and operational insights

- Design for scale and maintainability while staying pragmatic, shipping incremental value, gathering feedback, and iterating as you go

- Turn ambiguous business requirements from Finance, Revenue Ops, Marketing, and Product teams into well-scoped technical solutions with effort estimates

- Collaborate across our Hub & Spoke architecture, partnering with upstream data owner teams, downstream Looker/LookML developers, and other domain pods (Retail, Hospo, Operations) to design models that work end-to-end

- Treat documentation as a first-class deliverable: column descriptions, model contracts, and architectural notes that power both human reviewers and AI/LLM-assisted workflows

- Diagnose root problems, not symptoms, and drive systemic fixes rather than one-off patches

- Own pipeline health end-to-end: monitor proactively, lead incident response, and surface risks before they become delivery problems

- Autonomously manage personal sprint commitments and contribute to team-level planning, including task breakdown, effort estimation, and priority sequencing

- Mentor junior engineers through coaching, code reviews, and technical sessions, and set the bar for what good looks like

What you will bring to the team:

- Expert-level SQL: query performance, clean, maintainable code, and advanced analytical techniques (e.g. window functions)

- Proven experience designing enterprise-grade dimensional models on modern cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery or Snowflake, including partitioning, incremental patterns, and performance optimization

- Hands-on experience modelling SaaS / CRM / ERP source systems such as Salesforce or NetSuite, with a clear understanding of how their object models translate into clean dimensional schemas

- Proven Dataform or dbt expertise in production: materializations, incremental strategies, snapshots, and macros

- You communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, clarifying needs, surfacing tradeoffs, and driving alignment

- A security and compliance mindset: GDPR, SOX, and data access controls are part of the job, not an afterthought

- As a global company with employees and clients outside of Quebec, fluency in English as a working language is required for this position.

Some additional things that would be a bonus:

- CI/CD experience (e.g. GitHub Actions): automated testing, linting, and deployment workflows

- Python or JavaScript for data engineering tooling

- LookML or equivalent semantic layer experience

- Familiarity with data contracts for pipeline validation

- Experience using AI/LLM-assisted tooling to accelerate development workflows: code generation, documentation, debugging, or review

- Revenue/finance domain knowledge (ARR, MRR, NetSuite, revenue arrangements)

What’s in it for you:

- Real ownership: you'll own canonical

description:
Wanna join the adventure?
Loft Orbital is making space simple. We build and operate reliable, shareable satellites that give customers a faster, simpler path to orbit. By combining flight-proven spacecraft platforms with our own hardware and software, we make it easier to deploy missions in space.
As an Embedded Software Engineer, you'll develop the low-level software that brings our spacecraft hardware to life. You'll focus on hardware abstraction layers (HALs), device drivers, and hardware interfaces, working closely with hardware, FPGA, and systems engineers to integrate and debug complex electronics. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys digging into the details, solving problems at the hardware/software boundary, and seeing their code fly in space.

Who We Are

Loft: Space Made Simple. 

Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

title: Creative Marketing Project Coordinator
description:
Description
CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.
At CapsLock , people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.
﻿Role overview
Our creative team produces hundreds of video ads, images and ad copy variations every month, and we test them across our campaigns to find out what works best. Behind all of that is a fast-moving pipeline, and we’re looking for a Creative Marketing Project Coordinator to keep it running smoothly.
You’ll be working with a team of 15-25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers. You’ll turn ideas and requests into clear tasks, keep everyone aligned on deadlines, review the final work before it goes live, and make sure every asset gets launched and tested. Many of our workflows are already automated, and we’d love someone who enjoys finding smarter ways to work as we grow.
If you love bringing order to a busy environment, have a sharp eye for detail and are curious about the creative side of marketing, this role is a great place to grow. You’ll also be invited to brainstorming sessions and can contribute your own ideas to the creative process.
Responsibilities
Task & Pipeline Management

• Turn monthly creative requests (videos, images and ad copy) into clear, well-structured tasks in ClickUp (our project management system).

• Add briefs, guidelines and references to each task, and assign it to the right team member

• Agree on deadlines with each team and track every task from request to launch

• Keep an accurate record of all creative tests and their status at every stage

Cross-Team Coordination & Follow-Up

• Communicate daily with a team of 15-25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers

• Follow up proactively so deadlines are met and nothing stalls in the pipeline

• Flag delays and bottlenecks early and help resolve them

• Release approved assets to media buyers and confirm they have been received, launched and reviewed

Quality Control

• Review final images, videos and ad copy before launch against briefs, client guidelines and technical specifications

• Catch typos, formatting errors and visual glitches before assets go live

• Develop an eye for visual inconsistencies, such as AI-generated artifacts, distorted details or elements that don’t make sense in context

• Collaborate with team members on final reviews and approvals

Reporting & Documentation

• Maintain structured logs of what is live, what is in testing and what has been learned

• Prepare clear status updates and reports using automated data and AI tools

• Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards

Process Improvement & AI

• Identify repetitive work and use AI tools and automations to streamline the workflow

• Help scale the pipeline to handle 100-350 tasks per month without losing accuracy

• Suggest improvements to task structure, templates and handoff processes

Creative Collaboration

• Take part in team brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas

• Turn raw concepts from brainstorms into structured, actionable tasks

• Build an understanding of our creative work and what performs well, with room to grow into the creative side over time

Requirements
Must-Have Skills

• Proven ability to manage a high volume of tasks with strict deadlines and accurate tracking

• Ability to turn requests and ideas into clear, structured tasks

• Confidence in following up with many people

title: Director of Product Marketing

Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.
Summary of Position
The Director, B2B Product Marketing leads strategy and commercialization for Teladoc Health ’s enterprise solutions, translating product capabilities, clinical outcomes, buyer needs, and market dynamics into differentiated positioning and go-to-market strategies.
This leader connects Product, Marketing, Sales, Clinical, Client Management, and other client-facing teams to ensure solutions are clearly positioned, commercially ready, and tied to member and business outcomes.
Reporting to the Head of Product Marketing, this role advances B2B priorities within the broader B2B2C strategy. Success requires simplifying complexity, influencing senior stakeholders, and turning insight into actionable narratives, plans, and tools.

Key responsibilities

•
B2B positioning and narrative: Own positioning, value propositions, and messaging for priority enterprise solutions, segments, and buyers. Translate complex capabilities into clear customer value and align messaging across customer-facing teams.

•
Core sales assets and buyer enablement: Create scalable pitch decks, sell sheets, messaging guides, FAQs, competitive positioning, proof points, and training that support acquisition, retention, and expansion. Partner with B2B Marketing, Content, and Creative on broader execution.

•
Go-to-market and launches: Lead B2B go-to-market strategy and commercial readiness for priority offerings. Define audiences, buyer needs, positioning, readiness requirements, and success measures; partner with Product on commercialization and B2B Marketing on activation.

•
Customer adoption and value: Develop value stories, use cases, and proof points across consideration, adoption, renewal, and expansion. Connect enterprise value to member awareness, utilization, outcomes, and buyer ROI.

•
Cross-functional leadership: Lead complex initiatives through influence, clarify roles and decisions, and serve as the Product Marketing partner for assigned solutions. Align priorities, resources, launches, and market strategy with the broader portfolio.

What success looks like

• Clear, differentiated positioning aligned to the broader portfolio.

• Scalable sales assets that strengthen enterprise buyer conversations.

• Faster launches with clear readiness, ownership, and measurable outcomes.

• Insights that shape product, commercialization, and growth decisions.

• Stronger links between buyer value, member outcomes, and acquisition, renewal, and expansion.

• Product Marketing recognized as the bridge between product strategy, customer needs, growth, and member value.

Qualifications

• 8+ years in marketing, including significant B2B product marketing, go-to-market strategy, commercialization, or solution marketing experience.

• Enterprise buyer fluency, with demonstrated experience marketing complex products or solutions and navigating multi-stakeholder buying processes.

• Proven ability to develop differentiated positioning, value propositions, messaging frameworks, and core commercial enablement assets.

• Track record leading product launches and commercial readiness across complex, cross-functional organizations.

• Experience using market research, voice-of-customer inputs, and competitive intelligence to shape positioning, roadmap inputs, and commercialization strategy.

• Strategic and hands-on leader who can connect narrative, enablement, launch readiness, customer value, and measurement to business outcomes.

• Healthcare, digital health, benefits, insurance, technology, or other regulated, multi-stakeholder industry experience preferred.

Job Location: Boston, MA
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time
Job Seniority Level:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company - we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
The Role
We are seeking an experienced regulatory operations professional to serve as our Senior Regulatory Domain Expert for Veeva Falcon. If you are a process-driven optimizer who is frustrated by the manual data-entry, repetitive checking, and data-chasing inherent in traditional Regulatory Information Management (RIM), this is your opportunity to help design a tech-forward solution. You will bring your deep knowledge of global submission lifecycles and health authority data standards to bear, advising our product and engineering teams as they build next-generation automation tools. Actively partnering with early adopter companies, you will serve as the definitive "Voice of the Customer" to replace legacy manual processes with intelligent digital labor.
What You'll Do

•
Product Advisory & Workflow Guidance: Guide product and engineering teams on the real-world operational nuances of global regulatory planning, dossier compilation, and the complexities of health authority data standards (e.g., IDMP, SPOR)

•
Output Verification & Quality Gatekeeping: Actively review, test, and provide expert feedback on platform outputs-verifying automated metadata tagging, health authority data mapping, and submission readiness tracking to ensure zero regulatory discrepancies

•
Stress-Test Scenario Curation: Build a comprehensive library of real-world regulatory scenarios, complex global submission sequences, and data edge cases to challenge and refine platform performance

Requirements

• 7+ years of active experience in Regulatory Affairs or Regulatory Information Management (RIM) within a pharma, biotech, or CRO environment

• Deep operational familiarity with global regulatory submission lifecycles (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA) and eCTD publishing standards

• Strong, working knowledge of data maintenance requirements within mainstream RIM systems (e.g., Veeva Vault)

• Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a track record of translating complex regulatory requirements into actionable guidance for non-regulatory stakeholders

• A passion for learning about agentic AI and an adaptive mindset regarding how automation can transform regulatory data compliance

Nice to Have

• Prior experience contributing to system configurations, data migrations, or user-acceptance testing (UAT) for enterprise regulatory software deployments

• Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
